text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since the debut 
race... True to our established strategy, 
we spent each day devoting ourselves 
entirely to physical conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I look forward to working 
with you today as well.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Looking forward to working with you, 
Believe.
Yeah. I'm counting on you, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed over the menu while answering. 
Today, as always, we would start the 
morning with a light run followed by 
thorough dynamic stretching—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Bodyweight training for the rest of the 
time. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"—Taaaaah!! ...Phew! Going all out first 
thing in the morning really feels great!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right! Since we're here, let's do one 
more— Wait, whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Has she been doing bodyweight 
training this entire time? Pretty sure she 
was doing that when we got here... right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~, that's wild... If it were me, I'd 
totally get bored halfway through...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"All right~ time to hit the weights! Using 
all kinds of machines is surprisingly fun, 
isn't it~— Wait, whoa!? That girl from 
this morning again...!?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Jump rope hell this time? Ugh, brutal...! 
It's important, yeah, but it's so plain 
and tedious..."
choice_data_list: （…Yeah, that's just how it is, huh…!）

（…Yeah, that's just how it is, isn't 
it…!）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though I didn't say it out loud, I deeply 
agreed. Lately, all of Believe's training 
has been strictly plain, unglamorous, and 
steady."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the goal were simple muscle building, 
using flashy machines with heavy loads 
would offer plenty of satisfying training, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What we're aiming for is solidifying the 
basics. Focusing thoroughly on bodyweight 
training and improving physical stability 
comes first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Increasing muscular endurance through low 
load and high repetitions, while carefully 
repeating each individual movement..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It makes logical sense. The issue is that, 
to her, it's "utterly plain, tedious, and 
boring"—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Cool-down finished.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's it for me today. I'll be in 
your care again tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Yeah, good work...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. You too, Trainer. —Until next time.
choice_data_list:
(Believe... gets things done so 
matter-of-factly.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You have your job, and I have mine. I will 
see mine through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I simply believe that is just the way 
things are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words I once heard come rushing back. Ever 
since those days, her stance hasn't 
changed in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer is doing their job as a trainer." 
"So I will see my own job through to the 
end as well"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It showed her earnestness, and at the same 
time... a kind of trust she placed in my 
role as her Trainer.
choice_data_list: (And that's exactly why—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in my room, looking at the assembled 
training menu, I clench my fist tight. 
Thinking of her sweating day after day, 
working in silent dedication, my resolve 
solidifies.
choice_data_list:
Even more. I have to become a Trainer 
worthy of their trust.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right there—!

text_block_list.name: Other Team's Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Ah, there you are! Believe-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Other Team's Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Phew, sorry out of the blue. This pen! It 
looks like it belongs to your Trainer. 
Could you hand it to them?

text_block_list.name: Other Team's Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"She probably dropped it the other day 
when she came by to watch our training~."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Observe training?

text_block_list.name: Other Team's Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yep! I come here all the time!

text_block_list.name: Other Team's Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she's going around visiting 
the veterans who were provisionally 
contracted with Believe-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—I see, so you came to study. Sure thing. 
After all, I entrusted her to you!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
The group the sub-trainer is watching over 
there will be great reference. After all, 
they're right in the middle of solidifying 
their fundamentals too!
choice_data_list: Understood, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
“—Exactly. That's why our policy is to 
watch lots of real races, study them, and 
apply that to our daily training.”

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Want to see my race analysis note format? 
It might help you know what to look for 
when watching.
choice_data_list: By all means...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
I believe there is... a close connection 
between mental management and nutritional 
management.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
"An acquaintance of mine is giving a 
lecture on the same topic. Would you like 
to come along?"
choice_data_list: Yes, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Other Team's Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Or so it seems. The most recent time she 
came over was... two days ago, I think?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Two days ago... was, if I recall...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Today was my rest day...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. Regarding meals, I'll try 
doing that.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. If you ever need advice, just let me 
know anytime.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Her explanations... are getting easier 
and easier to understand.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(They're honing their skills too. Day in, 
day out... All for the sake of the job, 
every single day.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...For the sake of our work together—)
choice_data_list: Hmm... Believe, what's wrong?
Hmm... Believe, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......Trainer, what about...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: What do you usually eat?
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, I see. Since you're not running, 
that's... fine, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Umm... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The pen I handed you earlier. Is that... a 
familiar tool to you?
choice_data_list:
Y-Yeah, I've been using it for a long 
time...

Y-Yeah, I've been using it for a long 
time...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I see. ...Does it write smoothly?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You're always taking notes, aren't you? In 
your binder, all the time...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, like assessing your condition and 
finding areas to improve...

Yeah, like assessing your condition, 
finding areas to improve...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...So that's how you look at it. 
Training, that is."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Always, by the side of the track, just 
like that—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A question. May I continue for a little 
longer?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, of course that's fine, but...!
Y-Yeah, of course it's fine, but...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...From that day on. Little by little, 
Believe began to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She began asking me from time to time 
about my side of things. More 
specifically, about my 'work.'

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So these are notes from the Trainer 
Academy days... I see, this is what the 
classes were like...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You've... kept this all this time, haven't 
you?
choice_data_list: It's basically like a good luck charm.
It's basically like a good luck charm.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The trainer training institution overseen 
by the URA... A two-year program... What 
was it called again?
choice_data_list: Yes, and then I took the licensing exam.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
To a Trainer belonging to Tracen 
Academy...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, though... you can 
also qualify to take the license exam by 
completing two years of practical trainer 
training, right?
choice_data_list:
Oh right, there are all sorts of 
differences compared to the field team—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In the case of rookie Trainers, you're 
treated as a provisional team until you 
gather five team members... Does anything 
change once we become an official team?
choice_data_list: First off, we'll get a big clubroom...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... a lot of rookie trainers end up 
becoming sub-trainers on veteran teams, 
right?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that happens a lot especially with 
the hands-on group.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Could it be because of their 
master-disciple relationship? I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And occasionally... she would even ask 
Believe questions of her own accord.

text_block_list.name: Believe
Believe
text_block_list.text:
In the afternoons... depending on the day 
of the week, there's sports science, 
nutrition, race strategy, vocal training, 
dance lessons—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Also, today... we got quite a lot of 
English homework.
choice_data_list:
English... If that's what it is, maybe I 
can help a little?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. English isn't really a 
problem for me. ...I listen to English 
radio broadcasts every now and then, too—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If we go to the cafeteria for lunch, it's 
all-you-can-eat, but... it gets quite 
crowded... and noisy, so—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Here, it's mostly store-bought food or 
boxed lunches...
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, there was a field 
inside the academy grounds...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It feels like my grandpa's 
neighborhood... It calms me down, a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Days like that, together. Stacking them 
up bit by bit, little by little—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa, phew...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Uphill track... that's the last run, 
right?
choice_data_list: Right, this is it. Give it your all!
Yep, this is the end. Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (I run. ...I will do my job.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Still...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Before my job, there is Trainer's job.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Beyond my job, lies Trainer's job.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!! Haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Beneath the ground I run on...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (His work... is undeniably right here—!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Aaaahhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!! Haaah, haaah, haaah... phew...
choice_data_list: Good work, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I look forward to the next menu as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And one day. Having finished lunch, I 
headed to the Trainer's Room to spend the 
rest of my break there, when—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: Oh, Believe! You came?
Oh, Believe! You're here?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. I'll clean this up right 
away—
choice_data_list: Ah, totally fine by me!
No, not at all, it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This place is, in a way, meant for myself 
and Believe. I tell her to feel free to 
use it however she likes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll continue.
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if we've gotten a little 
closer...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I looked at Believe's 
hands. Come to think of it, I heard the 
other day that stone carving was her 
hobby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you feel this is a place where you can 
silently immerse yourself in your hobbies, 
that makes me happier than anything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt that I must continue striving in my 
work so that I can keep providing such 
peace of mind.
